name: easyfpl
description: EasyFPL — static FPL analysis site. No bundler by design; see eslint.config.js.

scripts.log: git log --oneline --invert-grep --grep='^Update FPL data' --grep='^Refresh live FPL data'
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check:globals && npm run check:versions && npm run check:inline && npm test
